# Bomhound

> High-performance CLI and Go library for enriching CycloneDX SBOMs with unabridged copyright notices and legal attribution (Apache 2.0 §4c / 17 U.S.C. § 1202).

## Core Capabilities
- Legal Attribution Compliance: Solves Apache 2.0 §4c and 17 U.S.C. § 1202 by preserving unabridged author copyright statements.
- CycloneDX Standards Compliant: Uses official `cyclonedx-go` serializers to emit standardized `Evidence.Copyright` structures.
- Vanity URL Resolution: Maps Go vanity domains (`k8s.io/*`, `golang.org/x/*`, `gopkg.in/*`) and NPM registries back to true git repositories.
- Content-Addressed Local Cache: Eliminates network rate limits with local SHA-256 license caching.

## CLI Usage
- `bomhound enrich --input <sbom.json> --output <enriched.json>`: Injects legal copyright notices into CycloneDX SBOM.
- `bomhound resolve --domain <package>`: Resolves custom vanity domain to upstream git repository.
- `bomhound parse --file <license-file>`: Parses raw license file and extracts author lines.

## Key Files & Paths
- Local Cache: `~/.bomhound/cache/`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
